cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder for first choice at the barbecue. Confirm the food part before you take it, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't it just be a favor between friends?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A favor is an advance, not a cancellation. What will you do when I need one?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold the ladder when you paint your gutter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One full afternoon, then. Please don't put 'hold ladder' down without a duration. I'll trade this weekend's loan for that; agreed?

reason: B's friendship becomes an actual reciprocal service; A prices its duration through expert bargain drafting.
